design.parent: v74 monthly calibration; primary transfer on prepared v75
design.change: calibrate the predicted reference-population mean instead of all eligible departures
design.frequency: stand/runway counts in allowed training plus held input months; no targets
design.reference_mass: TOTAL_REF_NB_FL / VALID_FL of the local eligible population
design.ordering: most frequent cells first; equal frequency receives equal fractional weight

composition.composition: airport intercept + invalid share + no-reference share
composition.regression: Huber 20 seconds; ridge 0.001; equal airport-month weighting
composition.train_selection: stand and runway present, true taxi <=2h
composition.calendar: airport local month; cells below100 rows unchanged
composition.limitation: Unobserved deicing, reference eligibility and helicopter exclusions; true/predicted truncation mismatch
composition.validation: same allowed Jan/Jul training months; no selected airport gate

design.limitation: Reference availability only approximated; deicing and some aircraft exclusions remain unknown
design.evaluation: reused Jan/Jul development; source audit motivated this experiment

interpretation: Approximate reference coverage, no exact source-identity claim; no production or upload selected
